summary.result: Since the SFE/P decrease with increasing temperature, the probability of rainfall rather than snowfall can increase if global warming continues.
summary.background: The effects of recent climate change on hydrological systems could affect the Winter Olympic Games (WOG) because the event is dependent on suitable snow and ice conditions to support elite-level competitions.
summary.method: Notably, a significant negative trend of SFE/P at Daegwallyeong in February, the month of the WOG, was attributable to a larger decrease in SFE related to the increases in maximum and minimum temperature.

summary_ko.method: 특히, WOG가 열리는 2월에 대관령에서 SFE/P의 유의미한 부정적 추세는 최대 및 최소 온도 상승에 따른 SFE 감소가 더 크기 때문에 발생하였다.
